5695.title: Plugin HTTP disconnect lifecycle
5695.rootCauseOneLine: Lazy abort initialization misses an earlier disconnect, and the dispatcher never cancels a response body returned after socket closure.
5695.proposedFix: Capture the request signal before awaiting plugin work and cancel a late response body when that signal is already aborted.
5695.caveats: Verified through BB's real plugin HTTP runtime, not the macOS desktop or private production fork. No provider-account incident or dependency upgrade was tested.
